description: Header file defining functions for managing Android binder process thread pools and polling mechanisms.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_startThreadPool
methods.description: Creates a threadpool for incoming binder transactions if not already created.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_setThreadPoolMaxThreadCount
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of threads in the threadpool.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_isThreadPoolStarted
methods.description: Checks if the threadpool has already been started.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_joinThreadPool
methods.description: Adds the current thread to the threadpool.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_setupPolling
methods.description: Provides an fd to wait on for binder commands, used in single-threaded processes.

methods.name: ABinderProcess_handlePolledCommands
methods.description: Handles queued binder commands when data is available on the fd.
